property_summary: For any caller other than the deployer (admin), setOwner must revert and leave owner unchanged; the mutant checks owner instead of admin so a non-admin caller can change owner (once owner differs from admin the guard passes).
For any admissible caller and any address, a successful call to setOwner by the admin always returns true; the buggy version returns false for every such call.

For any address proposed by the admin, setOwner must make c.owner() equal the proposed address; the buggy version instead sets owner to the caller, so choosing a proposed owner different from the admin breaks the rule.
